_doc: Plugin release identities for the Early Access identity gate (`npm run launch:check`, announce and open builds). AICC_EA_PLUGIN_RELEASE_SHA256 must be one of the `allowed` hashes and none of the `superseded` ones. Adding an `allowed` entry is a CONSCIOUS ACT: do it in its own commit, only when a new Plugin build has been attested (built from the corrected source, ZIP hashed, and, for a release, signed). The Site build never reads this file or the variable.

allowed.note: Corrected Plugin ZIP (feat/p21-guarantee-fix): no 14-day money-back message on a free grant. NOT signed yet: the entry records the candidate, not a release approval; replace or add the signed hash when the owner signs.

superseded.reason: Plugin 1.1.0 candidate that shows a 14-day money-back message on a free grant
